brand_identity.tagline: AI-Powered Luxury Real Estate Intelligence for Hyderabad
brand_identity.tone: Sophisticated, trustworthy, warm, high-touch, and technologically advanced

visual_theme.user_preferences: Premium charcoal, white and gold visual identity with responsive mobile-first UI. Simple and effective.

typography.heading_font: Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond / Cabinet Grotesk (serif/display luxury aesthetic)
typography.anti_pattern_rule: DO NOT use Inter or standard Arial for Main and Sub-headings. Use Playfair Display or serif luxury display font for headings, Outfit for body text.

font_scales.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-white
font_scales.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-white
font_scales.caption: text-sm text-zinc-400

layout_and_spacing.border_padding_rule: Containers with border MUST have internal padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_marketing: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8
layout_and_spacing.mobile_first: Ensure all filter bars, cards, property modals, floating chatbot widgets, and admin lead tables collapse smoothly for mobile screens.

navigation_bar.style: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0F0F12]/85 border-b border-white/10 z-50 sticky top-0)

hero_section.visual: Immersive luxury real estate background with dark charcoal overlay (bg-black/50 to let dusk pool villa shine through)
hero_section.heading: Find Your Dream Sanctuary in Hyderabad
hero_section.subheading: AI-guided real estate discovery across Gachibowli, Kokapet, Financial District, Tellapur & beyond.
hero_section.search_bar: Unified interactive filter box with Buy/Rent tabs, Location selector, Budget slider, Property Type drop-down, Bedrooms selector, and 'Search with AI' button.

property_grid_and_cards.badge: Mandatory visible tag 'SAMPLE LISTING' (gold border + soft gold glow bg) on all 8 sample cards to meet problem statement requirements.
property_grid_and_cards.card_style: Dark charcoal background (#1A1A22), crisp 1px gold border on hover, subtle image scale transition, metadata pill badges (BHK, Sq.Ft, Location, Price).
features: Chat about this property CTA (pre-fills Chatbot context)

ai_chatbot_widget.name: Property Mitra
ai_chatbot_widget.type: Floating widget (bottom-right on public site) with notification badge & avatar
conversation_flow: Greeting & Persona introduction as UrbanNest AI Real Estate Advisor
Collect preferences: Preferred Location (e.g. Kokapet, Gachibowli), Budget Range (e.g. ₹1.5 Cr - ₹3 Cr), Property Type (Villa/Apartment), Bedrooms (2/3/4 BHK), Possession timeline
Display matching property cards right inside the chat bubble carousel with images & key specs
Collect User Name & Phone Number to request contact / site visit from UrbanNest agent
Store enquiry into Admin Lead Table in real-time

admin_dashboard.access: Protected login screen (Email/Password & Google sign-in demo)
widgets: Top Summary Cards: Total Enquiries, Buy/Rent/Sell ratio, Hot/Warm/Cold leads breakdown, Most popular location
Analytics Charts (Recharts): Leads by Location, Budget Distribution, Monthly Lead Trend
Lead Table: Filterable list with Lead Name, Phone, Intent (Buy/Rent/Sell), Budget, Target Location, Temperature Badge (Hot/Warm/Cold), Date
Lead Detail Drawer/Modal: Complete user requirements, matched properties, full transcript of Property Mitra conversation, AI summary, and One-Click Copyable WhatsApp Follow-Up Message
Listings Management (CRUD): Add new listing, edit price/details, toggle active/deactive status, update image URL or mock upload

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files as specified in project structure.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for actions like login success, inquiry submitted, WhatsApp text copied, and property added/edited.
Do NOT use transparent headers over text or dropdown menus with clear backgrounds - always apply solid or backdrop-blur backgrounds with subtle borders.

Ensure Property Mitra chatbot floating widget is easily accessible on mobile and desktop and leads generated are synced directly to local storage / memory state for the Admin Dashboard to read immediately.
Provide clear sample listing markers on cards and maintain high visual luxury with charcoal & gold theme.
